summary: BifrOSt has DEFLATE and zlib decoding and a simple DEFLATE encoder, both internal to the shell and the Files app, with no SDK API for apps. It has no LZFSE, LZ4, LZMA or ZLIB-algorithm selection, no streaming API, and no filter types.

DEFLATE and zlib only; output is capped at MAX_OUT (256 MiB) or a caller-declared size

gaps: No SDK compression API for apps (no bifrost_app module for buffer, stream or filter compression)
